baslik: The Jet That Slid Off a Snowy Runway Into a Street

sahneler.metin: In a snowstorm, a Boeing 737 slid off the end of a runway at Chicago Midway.
It crashed through a fence into a street, and a child in a car was killed.
The runway was covered in snow.
The thrust reversers were deployed late.
The jet needed more distance than it had.
Midway has little space beyond its runways.
Landing distance procedures were revised afterward.

aciklama:
Southwest 1248 slid off the runway into a Chicago street. The cause: runway overrun from contaminated runway, tailwind and late reverse thrust.
